turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A deaf colleague just joined my team and I'd like to learn some sign language.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a kind thing to do. An in-person class, or online videos you can watch at your own pace?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait, Zoe needs me for a sec. Please stay quiet until I come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you back from the dentist? How's your tooth?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Numb, I can't feel my lip.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Zoe, how was that tapas bar you tried last weekend?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Food was great, but it was so loud we had to shout.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm, I want somewhere we can actually talk. Was it pricey?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: About forty each with drinks. Not bad.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe we go early, before it gets busy.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Good plan. It's pretty calm before seven.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm back. You can talk now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, how are you going to start?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A class. I need someone to correct my hands.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great idea, signing really benefits from feedback. Maybe ask your colleague for a sign name too.
